spot.html_text: ‘True’ language use, as opposed to the mere production of sound, is according to Cordemoy a matter of “giving signs to one’s thoughts” (1968 196). Language is on his account an artificial system of signs, the purpose of which is to communicate our thoughts, the words standing as their representatives, to one another.
